summary: Bridgeline Digital, Inc. filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) under Rule 424(b)(5) related to an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $3,950,000 of common stock through WestPark Capital as sales agent. The shares are sold at prevailing market prices with a 3.0% commission. No special-situation event is present; this is a routine capital-raising shelf takedown. Nothing indicates a strategic transaction, activist campaign, restructuring, or forced management change. The filing is solely a securities offering under existing shelf registration. Investors should monitor dilution from ongoing ATM sales.
